title: 2023年12月 六级听力真题 (第1套)

sentences.english: In recent years, artificial intelligence has transformed numerous industries from healthcare to transportation.
sentences.chinese: 近年来，人工智能已从医疗保健到交通运输改变了众多行业。

sentences.english: Machine learning algorithms can now diagnose diseases with accuracy comparable to experienced physicians.
sentences.chinese: 机器学习算法现在能够以与经验丰富的医生相当的准确度诊断疾病。

sentences.english: Despite these advances, ethical concerns regarding privacy and job displacement remain significant.
sentences.chinese: 尽管取得了这些进步，关于隐私和就业岗位流失的伦理担忧仍然重大。

sentences.english: Researchers emphasize the importance of developing transparent and accountable AI systems.
sentences.chinese: 研究人员强调开发透明和负责任的人工智能系统的重要性。

sentences.english: The future of AI depends on balancing technological innovation with social responsibility.
sentences.chinese: 人工智能的未来取决于平衡技术创新与社会责任。

questions.question_text: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.options: ["A) Healthcare reform","B) AI and its impact","C) Transportation technology","D) Medical education"]
questions.explanation: The passage focuses on how AI has transformed industries and the ethical concerns involved.

questions.question_text: What ethical concern is mentioned in the passage?
questions.options: ["A) Data security","B) Privacy and job displacement","C) Environmental damage","D) High costs"]
questions.explanation: The speaker mentions ethical concerns regarding privacy and job displacement.
